title: Every InferenceAttacker subclass must explicitly declare calls_external_api (enforced, not just documented)
notes: Found as a real Silent gap via repo-pincer's claim-verification pass run alongside an adversarial (security-review-posture) read of the same code: get_attacker()'s compliance gate (issue #126, Tier 1) was correctly enforced for any attacker that declared calls_external_api, but a future attacker that forgot to declare it at all would silently inherit the base class's False and defeat the gate with no test failure -- every existing test exercised an attacker that already declared the flag one way or the other. Fixed via InferenceAttacker.__init_subclass__, which now raises TypeError at class-definition time if a subclass omits the declaration; SignatureMatchAttacker updated to declare it explicitly rather than inherit it. Re-derive if either file changes -- confirm the __init_subclass__ enforcement and its test coverage are both still present, not just that the files still compile.
